title: AIMA李可胜：五年规划点名另类资管，资金会来吗？
speaker: Kersheng Lee

segments.en: Ks David here. So what would I guess where the rubber literally meets the road here. What would change if you do get an explicit statement citing alternatives as a growth engine. So what are we likely to see then that we don't have today?
segments.zh: David问：如果规划明确把另类资管列为增长引擎，实际会带来什么变化？我们会看到哪些今天还没有的东西？

segments.en: Well, I think the plan has a has a useful role right David? It sets direction with the next five years rather than you know just one year and for fund managers that long-term horizon is itself a significance. So by offering a strong signal
segments.zh: 我认为规划有其作用，David。它设定的是未来五年的方向，而非仅仅一年。对资管经理而言，长期视野本身就有意义。通过释放强烈信号，

segments.en: We are allowing sort of naming the role alternatives industry play in the development of Hong Kong. And I think that really has its own value in itself because it would then allow policies, resources
segments.zh: 我们得以明确另类资管行业在香港发展中的角色。这本身就有价值，因为它能引导政策和资源。

segments.en: And we see the Hong Kong government taking a whole government approach and achieve executive is leading this push across all government. So this allows Hong Kong to build on recent success that we saw on the tax front for example
segments.zh: 我们看到香港政府采取整体政府的方式，行政长官领导跨部门推动。这让香港能在近期税务方面的成功基础上继续发展。

segments.en: And I think the industry recognized that Hong Kong government is responsive it listens. And I think this will allow us to take that conversation over the next five years
segments.zh: 我认为行业已认识到香港政府反应迅速、愿意倾听。这将让我们在未来五年继续推进这一对话。
